summary: Nasus Pharma Ltd furnished a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual and Special General Meeting held October 8, 2026. Shareholders approved, by the required majority, all agenda items except Proposal No. 4 as set out in the notice and proxy statement furnished September 4, 2026. The filing serves as a routine meeting-results disclosure under the 1934 Act and is incorporated by reference into the company's Form F-3 and Form S-8 registration statements. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or special-situation mechanics are disclosed; watch for the company's next periodic report for any strategic or capital-markets follow-on.
